extensionDescription.message: Translates complete web pages with selectable AI providers and a persistent local cache.

apiKeyRequiredDetails.message: Open Settings and configure a {provider} API key.

pageUnavailableDetails.message: The browser does not allow extensions on this page.

reloadAfterInstall.message: Reload the page after installing the extension.

translationSpreadingDetails.message: {language} text is being processed in parallel.

manualTranslationActive.message: One-time translation is active for this page.

showingOriginalDetails.message: Translation remains ready and can be restored from the local cache.

watchingPageDetails.message: Waiting for translatable text or a response.

privateTabDetails.message: Use one-time translation; page text will not be cached.

neverTranslateDetails.message: This website is on the never-translate list.

waitingForRuleDetails.message: {language} is not selected for automatic translation.

heroSubtitle.message: Accurate whole-page translation with persistent local caching.

providerDescription.message: Choose a provider, store its key locally, then load the models available to your account.

apiKeyPlaceholder.message: Leave blank to keep the current key

apiKeyHint.message: The key is stored only in local extension storage and is never displayed again.

translationDescription.message: The selected provider and model apply to every translated website.

automaticDescription.message: Choose source languages and exact websites that should translate without another click.

languageDetectionPrivacy.message: Detection runs locally in the browser. Page text is sent to the selected provider only after a rule matches.

alwaysSitesHint.message: One domain or origin per line. All paths on that origin are included.

neverSitesHint.message: These rules override automatic language detection.

textShimmerHint.message: Briefly highlight only text that is being translated.

protectedTermsDescription.message: Keep selected brands, people, product lines, and model names unchanged.

protectedTermsHint.message: One exact term per line. Matching is case-insensitive.

localCacheDescription.message: Identical phrases are reused without another API request.

cacheLimitHint.message: Default: 8,000 phrases. Hard limits: 20,000 phrases and 16 MiB.

privacyDescription.message: When you enable a website, its non-editable text is sent to the selected provider for translation. Form values and editable text are deliberately skipped.

keyStoredHint.message: The {provider} key is stored locally. Enter a replacement only when you want to rotate it.

keyEntryHint.message: Enter a {provider} API key, then load the models available to this account.
